Hi Samir —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Wed like to lock in the technical deep dive and ensure we have the right routing for any operational issues during the session (network, credentials, live data gating). A few asks from our side to get this scheduled cleanly: 

1) Can you confirm the primary and backup customer engineers who will be on the call? Wed like an engineer who can answer network/firewall and SSO questions.
2) Procurement: will you need a signed SOW/PO before demo access to a staging instance, or can we proceed under a mutual NDAs and follow up with procurement details after the session?
3) Time windows: proposing these 90-minute slots (PST) — Mon 12/21 10:00-11:30, Tue 12/22 13:00-14:30, Wed 12/23 09:00-10:30. If none work, send a couple of alternatives.

Ben (cc) will take the SE lead; hes got the runbook for this customer. Ive attached the pre-demo checklist and network whitelist template so your infra team can pre-fill before we grant staging access.

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.xlsx (runbook), network-whitelist.csv (template)

Thanks —
